resources.title: NCDP Data Standards and Procedures (citable)
resources.description: Field manual, data structure, naming convention, metadata schema, submitting a survey, QA/QC and the coastal change indicators, as one versioned set. Each revision has its own DOI and PDFs; this DOI always resolves to the latest.

resources.title: Read online: the current revision (wiki)
resources.description: Every page of the current locked revision, with its status and the revision in which it last changed.

resources.title: Data structure and processing levels
resources.description: Archive hierarchy, the L0-L4 processing levels, and where each file of a survey goes.

resources.title: File and directory naming convention
resources.description: Survey folders and product filenames: date, site, product and coordinate system. One file per product, at its native resolution.

resources.title: Metadata schema v5.0 (131 columns)
resources.description: The archive's survey record: every column in order, who fills it, and which are required.

resources.title: QA/QC protocol
resources.description: What is checked at intake and at NCI, what blocks, who acts on each finding, and the weekly archive audit.

resources.title: Coastal change indicators and site reports
resources.description: How the L4 indicators, the erosion warning, hotspots and site reports are calculated.

resources.title: How to submit a survey
resources.description: The portal's upload wizard step by step, SFTP for large deliveries, and what happens after upload.

resources.title: NCDP Field Manual (read online, current revision)
resources.description: Equipment, site selection, mission planning, flight operations, safety and data upload for volunteer RTK drone surveys. Part of the NCDP Data Standards and Procedures: the PDF and the Word version (for adapting, CC BY 4.0) of the current revision are on Contribute → Guides.

resources.title: Survey metadata template (CSV)
resources.description: Empty CSV with the 131 columns of schema v5.0, one per survey as <YYYYMMDD-Location>_ancillary.csv. Optional: the portal and the SFTP tools fill most of it from your files.

resources.title: Metadata schema v5.0 — machine readable (JSON)
resources.description: The 131 columns in archive order, plus the 28 Record columns generated for NCI's catalogue, for scripting.

resources.title: Metadata schema v5.0 — CSV
resources.description: The same schema as a table.

resources.title: QA/QC numeric thresholds
resources.description: Limits for GSD, RMSE, GCP error, DSM voids and point density.

resources.title: Design and application of coastal erosion indicators using satellite and drone data for a regional monitoring program
resources.description: McCarroll, Kennedy, Liu, Allan & Ierodiaconou (2024), Ocean & Coastal Management 253. Basis for the NCDP erosion warning (D1) and hotspot detection (D2) indicators.

resources.title: Citizen science for monitoring seasonal-scale beach erosion and behaviour with aerial drones
resources.description: Pucino, Kennedy, Carvalho, Allan & Ierodiaconou (2021), Scientific Reports 11, 3935. Method behind the sand/active beach mask (P2).

resources.title: NCDP-Australia on GitHub
resources.description: All program repositories, including the data standards.

resources.title: AuScope
resources.description: NCRIS capability funding the program.

resources.title: National Computational Infrastructure (NCI)
resources.description: Where NCDP data is archived, under project mm91.

resources.title: Coastal monitoring with UAV-derived shoreline and volume indicators
resources.description: Coastal Engineering (2026). Uses NCDP survey data.

resources.title: Citizen science unoccupied aerial vehicles
resources.description: Ierodiaconou et al. (2022), Continental Shelf Research 244:104800 — the published account of the NCDP citizen science UAV approach.
